bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: a filesystem census of the specimen lake. It proves what is on disk, not that any specimen is correct, complete or servable.
startup_reconciliation: counts are recomputed from the filesystem on every call; there is no cached roster to drift out of date
why_no_rate: a throughput rate needs two timestamped observations. Reporting one from a single reading would be a fabricated measurement.
